ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance with an estimated 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity (white/water spray) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark field across both lobes, interspersed with high-frequency, non-contiguous high-intensity white points (stochastic noise/water) and a concentrated high-intensity white cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45-55 degrees, showing sharp convergence at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular saw-tooth serrations clearly visible on the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe trailing edge is partially obscured by water spray, limiting pixel-level extraction of frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Generally concave trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips, marked by extreme irregularity on the left lobe's outer boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular cluster located on the far distal edge of the left fluke lobe; smaller individual white circular points scattered across the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textured, high-intensity white accumulation (consistent with biological encrustation) on the distal trailing edge of the left fluke.
